detail.longDescription: AI is honestly an amazing thing. I'm a vibe coder, and I've always gotten my work done with AI. But this is the first time I used AI to build an AI agent actually, I used an AI agent to build an AI agent.Almost all the AI agents out there right now are being built for developers. I'm talking about the open-source ones. RedCat's focus is beginner-friendly. I built a proper desktop app for beginners, so anyone can simply download it and start using it easily.I don't know how good it actually is, but my heart says the world should use this haha
